- WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA standard

## Accessibility Audit Cost

Accessible.org web accessibility audits cost $100 – $250 per page (or screen) and $25 – $100 for light pages/screens. Our audits follow best practices for ADA and EAA compliance. Our audit price is based on comprehensive manual evaluation using the WCAG 2.1 AA standard (or WCAG 2.2 AA). Audits are conducted in desktop environment with the client option to add mobile.

Our website accessibility audits are fully manual, formal evaluations conducted by technical accessibility experts who evaluate your website or other digital assets against WCAG 2.0 AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, or WCAG 2.2 AA standards.

Scope typically does not include all pages or screens, but rather a representative sample.

We use an automated scan as a review to ensure all issues correctly identified by a scan are included in our final audit report.

All Accessible.org auditors are certified DHS Trusted Testers. The DHS Trusted Tester Process is a manual test approach that aligns with the ICT Testing Baseline, and provides repeatable and reliable conformance test results.

### Digital Assets Audited

Accessible.org can audit all types of digital assets:

- Websites

- Web pages

- Web apps

- Mobile apps

- Platforms

- Dashboards

- Software

- Games

- Widgets

- Elements

- Components

- Portals

- Multimedia Players

### Evaluation Methodology

Accessible.org uses the following methodologies and environments when evaluating your digital asset(s):

- Screen Reader Testing

- Keyboard Testing

- Visual Inspection

- Code Inspection

- Automated Scan:

- AXE

- Color Contrast Analyzer Tool

- Browser Zoom:

- 200%

- 400%

- Assistive Technologies:

- Screen Readers: NVDA, JAWS, and/or VoiceOver.

- Browser Environments:

- Browsers: Chrome and Safari.

- Operating Systems:

- Windows (desktop)

- iOS (mobile)

- Device Environments:

- Audit includes desktop environment with client option to add mobile (iPhone).

By choosing our audit services, you will receive an excellent quality, easy to understand audit report that your team can take action on.

We can add other environments (e.g., MacOS and Android) upon request for an additional fee.

Our website accessibility audit cost breakdown shows you exactly how we determine your final audit price quote.

### Deliverables:

- Technical Audit Report Format: Excel Spreadsheet

- Includes detailed technical findings and specific issues identified during the audit

### Price

$100–$250 per page or screen, $25-$100 for light pages/screens

## VPAT / ACR

VPAT services start at $350 for the WCAG VPAT version. We will fill in and complete a Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) and create a detailed Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on our audit. Our ACR creation service is $350 (for the WCAG version) in addition to the price of the audit for your digital asset.

### Other VPAT Editions

- Section 508: $550

- EN 301 549: $650

- INT: $950

This documentation is essential for meeting procurement requirements. We can pause issuance so that your team has a chance to fix issues and we can validate. This results in a cleaner ACR (demonstrating a more accessible product or service) you can deliver to clients.

### Price:

$350 for the WCAG VPAT version.

## Technical Support

Our technical support hours are flexible and can be used for validation of fixes (to ensure the audit issues have been resolved).

Technical support also includes support for any accessibility or implementation questions your team has.

### Support Includes:

- Validation

- Questions Answered

### Price

$195/hour

## Accessibility User Testing Cost

User testing services for website accessibility (and other digital assets) cost $550 per session and are a best practice for ADA compliance. The price of user testing is discounted if you choose Accessible.org for audit and remediation services.

User testing is conducted by an accessibility professional with a disability, is an essential part of ensuring your digital assets are accessible to all users. We offer user testing at a discounted rate when combined with our audit and remediation services.

### Service Details:

- User Testing: Conducted by a professional who is blind or visually impaired, using screen reader assistive technology to evaluate your website or digital asset.

- Deliverable: You will receive a recording of the user testing session upon completion.

### Deliverables:

- Recording of the user testing session upon completion.

- User Testing Attestation

Note : User testing sessions include up to 10 pages or screens with a time duration cap of 30 minutes.

### Price

$550 per session

$450 per session if you choose us for audit services.

### Accessibility Remediation Cost

We will remediate your digital asset at the code level. This means we will fix the technically complex accessibility issues on your website, web app, or mobile app.

To be eligible for remediation, we must 1) audit your digital asset and 2) have full code access. The audit is necessary to ensure we know all accessibility issues that exist (we don’t accept outside audits to uphold quality). Full code access is necessary to ensure we’re able to make all fixes.

We validate our remediation.

#### Service Details:

- Remediation: Conducted by a technical accessibility expert with development experience. All fixed issues are reviewed and validated by auditor.

- Deliverable: You will receive your code remediated digital asset.

#### Remediation Includes:

- Technical code remediation

- Validation of remediation

Note: An audit and full code access is required for remediation.

### Price

$750 – $4,500 for most clients, $100 – $450 per page or screen, depending on volume and complexity.

## Document Remediation Cost

Document accessibility remediation costs start at $4.00 per page. The price of remediating PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets for WCAG 2.1 AA conformance depends on the document status and project scope.

We will remediate your documents to meet the highest accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 AA and PDF/UA standards. Documents include:

- Microsoft PowerPoint documents

- PDFs

- Microsoft Word documents

- Microsoft Excel spreadsheets

- Canva documents

We will manually test documents and fix accessibility issues according to WCAG 2.1 AA and WCAG 2.2 AA standards and PDF/UA. Each document will meet Section 508 criteria, pass the Adobe Acrobat accessibility check, and be individually tested with screen reader assistive technology.

Minimum order is $250.

### Deliverables

- Documents remediated for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA, PDF/UA conformance and/or Section 508 compliance, passing Adobe Acrobat and assistive technology checks.

- PAC Report for PDFs (where applicable)

### Price

- PDFs start at $4.00/page

- Word Documents start at $7.00/page

- PowerPoints starts at $7.00/page

## Accessibility Certification

Our website accessibility certification documents are provided free of charge ($0.00) as a result of our services. These documents include Accessible.org certification, user testing certification, and a statement of conformance.

Note that to be eligible for a statement of conformance or provider certification, your website or other digital asset must be fully WCAG conformant.

For a statement of partial conformance, your website must be fully WCAG conformant other than content that is outside of your control.

### Certification Includes:

- Statement of conformance

- Statement of partial conformance

- Accessible.org certification

- User testing certification

### Price

$0.00

As a bookseller, we believe that providing access to the written word is important, including content that may be considered objectionable. We carefully consider the types of content we make available in our stores and review our approach regularly, listening to feedback and investigating concerns from our customers. We reserve the right to remove content from sale if we determine it creates a poor customer experience.

Authors, publishers, and selling partners are responsible for adhering to our content guidelines. We invest significant time and resources to enforce these guidelines, using a combination of machine learning, automation, and dedicated teams of human reviewers. We’ll reject or remove content that does not adhere to these guidelines and promptly investigate any book when notified of potential noncompliance. We may also request additional information relating to your book before it's available for sale. If we remove a title, we let the author, publisher, or selling partner know and they can appeal our decision.

These guidelines apply to book content, including title, cover art, and product description.

Note: Books that are translations of another work must credit the translator and the original author in the contributor field. If the work is not a new translation and the translator is unknown, the publisher should list the translator as "Anonymous" in the contributor field.

### Contents

- [Illegal or infringing content](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#illegal)

- [Offensive content](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#offensive)

- [Artificial intelligence (AI) content](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#aicontent)

- [Poor customer experience](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#customerexperience)

- [Public domain content](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#publicdomain)

- [Score and lyrics for songs managed by copyright management companies (Japan Only)](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#Score%20and%20lyrics)

- [Report violations](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200672390#report)

### Illegal or infringing content

We take violations of laws and proprietary rights very seriously. It is the responsibility of authors, publishers, and selling partners to ensure their content doesn't violate laws or copyright, trademark, brand, privacy, publicity, or other rights. We will not accept content under copyright that is freely available on the web unless it’s provided by the owner of the copyright. In addition, we do not allow companion books based on copyrighted works (e.g., summaries, study guides, etc.) to be published outside the U.S. without written permission from the copyright holder.

### Offensive content

We don’t sell certain content including content that we determine is hate speech, promotes the abuse or sexual exploitation of children, contains pornography, glorifies rape or pedophilia, advocates terrorism, or other material we deem inappropriate or offensive.

### Artificial intelligence (AI) content (text, images, or translations)

We require you to inform us of AI-generated content (text, images, or translations) when you publish a new book or make edits to and republish an existing book through KDP. AI-generated images include cover and interior images and artwork. You are not required to disclose AI-assisted content. We distinguish between AI-generated and AI-assisted content as follows:

- AI-generated: We define AI-generated content as text, images, or translations created by an AI-based tool. If you used an AI-based tool to create the actual content (whether text, images, or translations), it is considered "AI-generated," even if you applied substantial edits afterwards.

- AI-assisted: If you created the content yourself, and used AI-based tools to edit, refine, error-check, or otherwise improve that content (whether text or images), then it is considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” Similarly, if you used an AI-based tool to brainstorm and generate ideas, but ultimately created the text or images yourself, this is also considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” It is not necessary to inform us of the use of such tools or processes.

You are responsible for verifying that all AI-generated and/or AI-assisted content adheres to all content guidelines, including by complying with all applicable intellectual property rights.

### Poor customer experience

Books for sale on Amazon should provide a positive customer experience. We do not allow descriptive content meant to mislead customers or that doesn't accurately represent the content of the book. We also do not allow content that’s typically disappointing to customers, including the examples provided in the [Guide to Kindle Content Quality](https://kdp.amazon.com/help?topicId=G200952510). We reserve the right to change the [categories](https://kdp.amazon.com/help?topicId=G200652170) of a book at any time to ensure a positive customer experience.

### Public domain content

We allow content that is in the public domain and no longer under copyright. However, to provide a better customer experience, we won’t allow undifferentiated versions of public domain titles if a free version is available in our store (as outlined in our policies for [Publishing Public Domain Content](https://kdp.amazon.com/help?topicId=G200743940)). We may ask publishers to provide proof that the content is in the public domain.

### Score and lyrics for songs managed by copyright management companies (Japan Only)
 Content containing scores and lyrics from songs managed by copyright management companies, including JASRAC, cannot be published on the Kindle Store.

### Report violations

If you believe a book violates our guidelines, please [report it](https://kdp.amazon.com/help?topicId=G200652490).

Guidelines for other categories of products can be found here:

- [Offensive and Controversial Materials](https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/external/200164670)

In the Audio Library in YouTube Studio, you can find royalty-free production music and sound effects to use in your videos.

 Music and sound effects from the YouTube Audio Library are copyright-safe. The Audio Library is found exclusively in YouTube Studio.

## Open the Audio Library

- Sign in to [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com/).

- From the left menu, select Audio library.

You can also access the Audio Library directly at [youtube.com/audiolibrary](https://www.youtube.com/audiolibrary).

## Search the Audio Library

### Find music

In the Music tab, use the filters and search bar to find tracks for your videos.

To find a certain track, enter a track title, artist, or keyword in the search bar. You can also use filters to find music by the track title, genre, mood, artist name, attribution, and duration (length in seconds).

Refine your search results by clicking the filter next to the artist, genre, or mood of individual tracks. You can sort your search results by track title, artist name, duration, or date by clicking their column names.

Save your favorite tracks by clicking the star icon next to the track title. To see a list of your favorite tracks, click the Starred tab.

 New releases are added to the Audio Library twice a month.

### Find sound effects

In the "Sound effects" tab, use the filters and search bar to find sound effects for your videos.

To find a certain sound effect, enter a track title or keyword in the search bar. You can also filter sound effects by category and duration (length in seconds).

## Play and download audio

To sample a track, click Play . If you like what you hear, hover over the date and click DOWNLOAD to get an MP3 file.

The track will continue to play as you browse the Audio Library. Using the controls on the audio player, you can pause, seek, and play the previous or next track.

## Give attribution

If you’re using a track with a [Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/) license, you must credit the artist in your video’s description. To generate attribution info you can use:

- Sign in to [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com/).

- From the left menu, select Audio Library.

- Find the track you want to use.

- Note: To browse all music with a Creative Commons license, click the filter bar Attribution required.

- In the "License type" column, click the Creative Commons icon .

- In the pop-up window, click Copy to copy the attribution text. You can now paste this info in your video’s description.

If you want to find music that has a standard YouTube Audio Library license that doesn’t require attribution, click the filter bar Attribution not required.
